# Motion kinetic type

The motion-kinetic-type recipe: the line builds word by word while one liquid highlight springs from word to word and shows each word inverted through a mask.

- Type: Motion kinetic type
- Skill: `magnifito-promo`
- Engine: `motion`
- Output: 1920x1080, 5 s, silent
- Video: [`../videos/s13-motion-kinetic-type.mp4`](../videos/s13-motion-kinetic-type.mp4)

## Recreate it with Claude Code

Install the plugin (see the repository README), open this folder, and give Claude this prompt:

> Use the magnifito-promo skill to make a 5 second 16:9 clip for Magnifito, a Bulgarian digital marketing agency, in the motion-kinetic-type style only: the line "Great businesses deserve to be seen online" builds word by word with the liquid highlight. Use the motion engine. Brand colours are warm browns on cream (#7a584c, #ae8c72, #f0eadf), Geist for type, English on screen.

## Recreate it by hand

From the repository root, one command renders this example exactly as committed:

```sh
npm run showcase -- s13-motion-kinetic-type
```

Or run the steps yourself from `showcase/s13-motion-kinetic-type/` (after `npm run build && npm link`):

```sh
mgvideo render . --format 16:9 --force
```

The finished file is `runs/*/final_output_*.mp4`. The config files in this folder are the inputs.
